description: Datadog monitor webhook for operational trend, dashboard, and remediation goals.

goal_template.objective_template: Investigate Datadog monitor {{alertname}} for {{service}} in {{environment}}. Search durable memory for prior occurrences, related incident notes, dashboard changes, PRs, and unresolved follow-ups. Decide whether this should create a code PR, dashboard PR, alert-tuning change, data-quality check, SLO review, or data-science trend analysis. Return evidence, trend summary, and concrete artifacts; do not mark the goal satisfied without either a validated fix path or a documented no-action decision. Dashboard: {{dashboard_url}}.
